note: adsense_oldcode is a submodule of adsense for legacy pre-2007 Google ad code (deprecated). Config object adsense_oldcode.settings, two forms (adsense_oldcode.settings at /admin/config/services/adsense/oldcode and adsense_oldsearch.settings at /admin/config/services/adsense/search), both requiring the parent 'administer adsense' permission. Defines five reusable ad styles (adsense_group_title_1.._5 with type/colour keys) and legacy search settings (adsense_search_*). Blocks: adsense_oldcode_ad_block (ad_format, ad_style, ad_channel, ad_align) and adsense_oldsearch_ad_block (ad_channel); plugins oldcode/oldsearch. All evals are grounded in local config and block placement (no live Google request); the parent's placeholder mode keeps it dev-safe.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal adsense_oldcode submodule do, and why is it not recommended for new sites?
evals.expected_output: It renders AdSense ad units and a search box using Google's pre-2007 ('old') ad code, which Google deprecated in 2007; it exists for legacy inventory only.

evals.prompt: Where do you configure the adsense_oldcode module's ad styles, and what permission is required?
evals.expected_output: On the Old Code Ads form at /admin/config/services/adsense/oldcode (route adsense_oldcode.settings), stored in the adsense_oldcode.settings config object; it requires the parent 'administer adsense' permission.

evals.prompt: Which block plugins does the adsense_oldcode submodule provide?
evals.expected_output: adsense_oldcode_ad_block (legacy ad unit; settings ad_format, ad_style, ad_channel, ad_align) and adsense_oldsearch_ad_block (legacy search box; setting ad_channel).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the first adsense_oldcode ad style has a name configured. Inspect the live configuration and give the exact title of ad style 1.
On this Drupal site, the adsense_oldcode legacy search box is set to a specific Google country domain. Inspect the live configuration and give that domain.
On this Drupal site, name the first adsense_oldcode ad style 'Sidebar Skyscraper'. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set adsense_oldcode.settings:adsense_group_title_1 to 'Sidebar Skyscraper' (e.g. drush cset adsense_oldcode.settings adsense_group_title_1 'Sidebar Skyscraper' -y, or on the Old Code Ads form).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place a legacy AdSense old-code ad block: create a block named 'adsense_oc_eval_ad' using the adsense_oldcode ad block plugin, with its AdSense channel set to 'oceval', in the content region of the default theme. Apply it to the live site. (Placeholder mode keeps it dev-safe.)
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity id 'adsense_oc_eval_ad' with plugin 'adsense_oldcode_ad_block' and settings.ad_channel 'oceval' in the default theme's content region, e.g. Drupal\block\Entity\Block::create(['id'=>'adsense_oc_eval_ad','plugin'=>'adsense_oldcode_ad_block','theme'=>\Drupal::config('system.theme')->get('default'),'region'=>'content','settings'=>['id'=>'adsense_oldcode_ad_block','label'=>'Legacy ad','label_display'=>0,'ad_channel'=>'oceval','ad_style'=>'1','ad_format'=>'468x60','ad_align'=>'center']])->save();
